headline: East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)

meeting.body: East Maui Regional Community Board (Water Authority)
meeting.summary: Members voted on a fiscal year 2026 budget request to the mayor and passed a motion letting members testify for the board.
meeting.recap: A member of the public said the board has a large body of supporters.[[0:06:42]] Members said the room was standing room only at the director's formal swearing-in.[[0:08:42]] The director proposed two new positions in the budget: a water resource specialist and a half-time intern.[[0:15:16]] The request also adds money for watershed programs, a strategic plan, and special counsel (outside lawyers).[[0:16:57]] The chair said a long-term East Maui water license item returned to the state land board's agenda on November 1.[[0:31:50]] The chair said the board got no advance notice.[[0:32:42]] Over 200 pieces of testimony were submitted, and over 90% were opposed, the chair said.[[0:35:20]] The chair said five land board members voted for a motion to deny the proposal.[[0:36:26]] The board went into executive session (a closed-door meeting) to talk with its attorney.[[0:43:49]] The board passed a motion letting members give testimony for it to other bodies, covering the time until its next meeting.[[1:00:06]] The chair said there is a request for a Water Commission update at the December 12, 2024 meeting on stream changes ordered in 2018.[[1:07:34]]
decided: With no objection, the board agreed to take up the budget request, item 5A, right after public testimony.
The motion letting members testify for the board before other bodies carried.
The board put off item 5B, a formal statement of its mission and goals.
meeting.next: Members are asked to send ideas for the director's goals to the board secretary. The director said she will report on her mainland conference at the next meeting. The chair said the board will revisit the testimony authorization to open it to other members.

moments.q: Motion to authorize members to testify for the board
